title: SBC Coffee School: 9.2-Bar Dial-In & Calibration
caption: Our hands-on slow-bar workshop: dialing in single-origin Chikmagalur lots on commercial 9-bar groups, understanding TDS extraction yields, and silky microfoam texturing.

title: Indirapuram Sanctuary Grand Launch & Community Jam
caption: Opening the doors to our flagship collegiate sanctuary in Indirapuram. 400+ neighborhood regulars, live slow-bar pourovers, acoustic chords, and midnight cold brews.

title: Bangalore Sarjapur Hub Launch: Taking SBC South
caption: Section-B Coffee landing in the craft capital of South India! Freshly roasted Western Ghats Arabica, signature sculpted bear lattes, and study bench vibes.

title: Sunday Morning Community Run Club & Cold Brews
caption: Every Sunday at 7 AM: neighborhood runners lace up for 5K around Indirapuram, finishing at Section-B for iced cold brews, electrolyte tonics, and sourdough truffle melts.

title: Signature Sculpted Bear Latte: The Meltdown Ritual
caption: Learning the art of Section-B's mascot bear latte: freezing double ristretto espresso bears and watching them gently melt over sweet condensed milk and steamed oat milk.

title: Wood-Fired Panuozzo & Almond Viennoiserie Pop-Up
caption: Hot out of the stone oven: authentic Italian pizza-dough sandwiches (Panuozzos) stuffed with fior di latte and wild mushrooms, paired with double-baked almond croissants.

title: Weekend Sensory Cupping: Western Ghats Terroir
caption: Evaluating roast curves, wet vs honey processing, and identifying natural notes of jasmine, toffee, and dark cocoa with fellow specialty coffee enthusiasts.

title: Desk 14 Midnight Study Sessions & Focus Blocks
caption: Laptops glowing, acoustic tracks softly humming through the speakers, and ice clinking in sparkling espresso tonics. Section-B remains your collegiate harbor.
